Live Google map/overlay/autocomplete CANNOT render in sandbox/CI because the browser Maps key is referrer-restricted to *.wecare.digital/*; a blank/absent map there is EXPECTED. Verify via the honest-degradation path (no key -> no map, no fetch) and the Google-stub tests, NOT by expecting a live map.

environment_constraints: Browser Maps key referrer-restricted to *.wecare.digital/* => no live map/overlay/autocomplete in sandbox; expected, not a failure. Do NOT hardcode a key; read ONLY from process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY. Honest degradation must hold: no key => no map, no overlay, zero network calls, left card still renders sensibly.
contribution_requirements: NO RED anywhere on the page. Google attribution MUST remain (Maps logo + .gm-style-cc legal; Place Photo author attributions visible/legible). No CSS targeting .gm-style-cc / a[href*="google"] / img[alt="Google"]. Keep overlays inset from map bottom corners. styled-jsx attaches its scope class ONLY to markup statically visible in the component return tree => keep ALL new left-card and right-map markup INLINE in VayuLokLive's return. Hero in src/pages/vayulok/index.tsx must stay UNCHANGED.
key_patterns: Single self-styled component src/components/VayuLokLive.tsx (~2675 lines) with one <style jsx> block, vl-live- class scope, tokens on .vl-live (--lime #d1f470, --green #1a3a2a, AQI ramp --aqi-good/sat/mod/poor/worst dark-green->lime->amber, no red). Current layout: .vl-live-grid two columns at >=1024px = LEFT (.vl-live-left) all live content stacked; RIGHT (.vl-live-right > .vl-live-map-sticky > .vl-live-map-stage) map with ON-MAP overlays (search .vl-live-map-search, layer controls .vl-live-map-controls incl. Expand/Collapse .vl-live-map-expand, photo overlay .vl-live-map-photos with .vl-live-photo-count number pill + referee SVG, legend .vl-live-scale-legend). Heatmap effect keyed on `layer` creates google.maps.ImageMapType with opacity HEATMAP_OPACITY (currently 0.35) and adds runtime class vl-live-overlay-lime to the canvas host; a scoped CSS filter (.vl-live-overlay-lime :global(div[style*="z-index"] img:not([alt]))) currently COLLAPSES tile hue toward flat lime. AQI mapType=UAQI_RED_GREEN, PM25=PM25_INDIGO_PERSIAN.
